product.name: Gaming Clan Finder for Indian Gamers
product.tagline: BGMI and Free Fire players find and join clans, organise scrims, and track team performance

sections.problem_statement: Indian mobile esports players struggle to find reliable, high-skill teammates, forcing them to rely on low-quality, toxic public discord servers and random in-game matchmaking. Existing solutions lack verified performance data, leading to 'scrim' coordination chaos and high churn rates in competitive clans. This product bridges the gap by providing a skill-verified matchmaking platform that automates team building and performance tracking for BGMI and Free Fire players.
target_users: Aryan 'SniperKing' Sharma: Aspiring Pro Player, Tier-3 Esports team player; struggles to find teammates who share his commitment to daily scrims and strategic practice.
Priya 'HeadshotQueen' Das: Clan Leader, Casual Gaming Community; finds it difficult to vet new recruits, often dealing with 'leechers' who join for clan rewards but don't contribute to gameplay.
Rohan 'Coach' Mehta: Independent Tournament Organizer; lacks a centralized tool to recruit teams for community-level tournaments and verify their previous match performance.
user_stories: As an aspiring pro, I want to filter teammates by K/D ratio and 'Role' (Entry Fragger/Support) so that I can build a balanced squad for competitive play.
As a Clan Leader, I want to set a 'minimum rank' and 'playtime' requirement for applicants so that I filter out inactive players automatically.
As a player, I want to sync my BGMI/Free Fire profile data so that my match history and stats are verified, proving my skill level to potential teams.
As a team captain, I want to schedule scrims with other teams via a calendar integration so that we can practice at consistent times.
As a competitive player, I want to view my team’s 'Win/Loss' trend chart so that I can identify our performance gaps and improve before the next tournament.
mvp_features: Verified Player Profiles: Integration with game APIs to display K/D, rank, and recent match performance to build trust in the ecosystem.
Smart Clan Finder: A Tinder-style swiping interface with filters for region, play-style (Aggressive vs. Passive), and competitive intensity.
Scrim Scheduler: A centralized dashboard for clans to post 'Scrim' requests, set entry requirements, and manage participant lists.
Clan Leaderboard: A community-driven ranking system based on scrim performance and tournament participation to highlight top-performing clans.
In-App Chat & Voice Lobby: Dedicated spaces for clans to coordinate outside of the game, reducing reliance on fragmented WhatsApp groups.
Compliance Dashboard: A secure onboarding flow compliant with the DPDP Act, ensuring user data privacy and age-gating for minors.
future_features: AI-Powered Matchmaker: Automated team suggestions based on playstyle compatibility and timezone availability.
Tournament Hosting Engine: Integrated payment gateway for entry fees and prize pool distribution via UPI/Escrow.
Pro-Scouting Portal: A section where top-tier esports organizations can view performance data to scout new talent.
Anti-Cheat Verification: Partnerships with community tools to flag players with a history of toxicity or hacking.
success_metrics: Day-30 Retention: Target 25% by month 6 — indicates the platform is becoming a daily utility for clan management.
Verified Profiles: 50,000 profiles synced by month 4 — critical mass required to make the 'Finder' feature effective.
Scrim Completion Rate: 70% of scheduled scrims resulting in a match — measures the reliability of the matchmaking system.
Clan Growth: 5,000 active clans created by month 6 — core indicator of network effect and platform stickiness.
assumptions: BGMI and Free Fire APIs remain accessible or allow for community-driven data scraping/syncing.
Indian gamers are willing to share game-profile data in exchange for better team-finding capabilities.
Mobile remains the primary device for the target demographic, prioritizing a mobile-first app experience.
risks: Data Privacy Violations (DPDP Act) → Implement strict data minimization policies and clear opt-in consent flows during registration.
Platform Toxicity/Harassment → Build a robust community reporting system and automated moderation using AI to shadow-ban toxic users.
Low User Trust in Verification → Partner with popular gaming influencers for early endorsement and utilize official game ID verification (UID).
sections.go_to_market: Launch via Discord partnerships and 'Clan Recruitment' campaigns led by micro-influencers in the BGMI/Free Fire community. Execute a 'First 100 Clans' program where top community leaders get premium 'Verified' badges and early access to tournament hosting features. Use viral referral incentives where players get profile boosts for inviting their squad-mates to the platform.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Use Flutter for a cross-platform mobile experience to maintain a unified codebase for Android and iOS. Deploy on Firebase for real-time database capabilities (essential for chat and live scrim updates) and serverless cloud functions. Integrate with Supabase for robust authentication and Postgres-based relational data handling for stats.
sections.monetisation: Freemium model: Free for basic matchmaking, with a 'Premium Clan' tier at ₹199/month offering advanced analytics and prioritized scrim listings. Introduce a 'Tournament Entry' transaction fee (3-5% service charge) for hosted prize-pool matches. Future revenue includes sponsored 'Featured Clan' placements for brands looking to reach specific gaming demographics.
